title: Grandma's shoebox
body: Your aunt hands you a shoebox from Grandma's room. Old photos. A land deed dated 1978. A letter in your grandfather's handwriting about "a share that will make this family whole." It names a bank in Zurich and a box number.

choices.label: Keep everything. Read the letter again tonight.
Pay a lawyer $300 to look at the deed.
Leave the box with your aunt.
